zh-CN.title: 语音转写展示优化
items: 语音转写改为下方独立引用框，匹配各款气泡材质并保持底色清晰；语音长度随时长变化，长文本保持舒适阅读宽度
修正首页语言选择按钮的异常椭圆外形
七个主 Tab 统一页面面板与标题栏风格，修正深色聊天列表的旧底色覆盖；手机滚动后浮现背景，适配深浅与生日皮肤

en.title: Voice transcript layout
items: Transcripts appear as separate readable quotes matching each bubble skin, with duration-based playback widths and comfortable text widths
Corrected the stretched oval shape of the homepage language selector
Unified panel and header materials across all seven main tabs, removed legacy dark chat-list colors, and retained mobile scroll elevation and theme support
